claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic durable local state placement/migration/update/rollback planning primitive for Frankenstein 2.0. It must preserve one canonical state lineage outside disposable host/plugin/cache roots, require explicit current and target state-root identities, generation and state digest fences, represent COPY/VERIFY/SWITCH/ROLLBACK as a typed plan only, reject aliasing a disposable cache as canonical state, reject silent second-lineage creation, preserve source state until independent verification, and require explicit rollback identity. No filesystem mutation, installer execution, UnifiedDB content mutation, host probing, provider/model/tool invocation, effects, physical-host credit or whole-system completion. Source/tests and repository-hosted CI only.
